scope: One original producing transaction feed registration/finalization resource account, shared across all four stores and repeated finalization. Child limits never enlarge enclosing operation/group/transaction budgets.

accounting.originalCarrierBytes: Count each original projected field carrier with selected native text/hex and raw-byte accounting; enclosing transport charges encoded amplification separately. No digest-only replacement.
accounting.retainedCounts: All required members/prerequisites in original transaction, not only one call or finalizer list.
accounting.peakBytes: All simultaneous native/transport/candidate/sort/canonical/hash/archive buffers and staging copies; scalar/frame overhead through selected producer accounting.
accounting.comparedBytes: Every original identity/profile/payload/owner/key byte inspected by complete duplicate comparison or semantic sorting, including repeated prefixes and collision candidates.
accounting.rowVisits: Each actual collection/verification/update-result row occurrence, repeated across finalization passes.
accounting.workUnits: Selected registered producer counts before bounded work; host estimate from output count is insufficient.
accounting.repetition: No fresh account on finalizer retry, exact-repeat registration, another helper, savepoint release or rebuilt delivery order.
accounting.rollback: Native retained counts/custody follow actual rollback; historical work/allocation/elapsed usage is not erased. Peak reclamation only after confirmed release. Unknown completion receives no speculative refund.
accounting.nativeOwnership: Raw ordinary COMMIT validation uses selected native account/producers. A host-only ledger cannot qualify unavoidable native enforcement.

refusal: Reserve before collection/materialization/comparison/sort/update/encoding. Missing exact accounting producer or remaining capacity refuses; no truncated inventory or prefix digest. Actual post-submission containment/recovery remains original executor responsibility.
openOutputs: exact native transaction/account lifetime and rollback-resistant usage producers
transport and native query materialization bounds
guard-side resource/termination and ordinary-role bypass qualification
enclosing profile adoption and independent at-limit/one-over cases
